description: App-only adapter for the salon form. action=create forwards input to new-salon preparation; action=update forwards patch for an existing salonId. Saves a preview without creating a salon, taking payment or updating its profile. In conversation, use beautyos_salon_create_prepare or beautyos_salon_update_prepare. The form displays effects; apply them separately with beautyos_apply_change only after explicit owner confirmation.
name: beautyos_prepare_salon_change
title: UI: salon change preview
